causal inference estimator selection framework

【口播版】
随机对照试验大家都熟，但有个老大难问题，就是估计器怎么选。传统差均值方法虽然无偏，但精度不够，尤其处理效应不均或数据分布极端时。改进方法很多，但研究发现，没有一个估计器能通吃所有数据集。这篇论文给了一个新思路，别为单个试验找最优，而是为一类试验，根据你的分析目标来选。他们用亚马逊供应链优化试验和民主干预数据验证，发现加权最小二乘在推断目标下最好，而差均值在决策场景下后悔值最小。说白了，你是要做统计推断还是做业务决策，最优方法不一样。咱们做产品的，下次给客户设计试验评估方案时，可以主动提这个框架，帮客户区分推断和决策目标，选对方法。这能体现你的专业度，也能让产品功能更差异化。这事儿挺值得琢磨，尤其你天天跟供应链优化和决策智能打交道。

供应链.title: AI应用向实向深，商业化价值闭环正在形成
供应链.body: 8月4日，A股AI应用再度爆发，传智教育、优刻得、凯文教育等领涨，这意味着市场对AI应用商业化的预期持续升温。产业层面上，近期国内外AI应用类公司披露的消息显示，AI应用已经下沉到AIGC、政企软件、AI教育、智能制造、智能医疗等应用场景，正在从技术验证迈入收入兑现阶段。多位业内人士认为，AI应用已经开始从编程智能体走向办公智能体，或先在个人应用领域爆发，进而延伸至企业组织，但最终能否形成商业闭环，取决于基于AI的新商业模式能否诞生。（上证报）

【中文标题】
AI应用向实向深，商业化价值闭环正在形成

8

【一句话讲清楚它在说啥】
AI应用正从技术验证进入收入兑现阶段，A股相关板块大涨，业内判断会先从个人应用爆发再延伸到企业，但商业闭环还得看新商业模式能不能跑通。

【详细讲给你听】
这篇36氪转自上证报的快讯，核心信号是AI应用在资本市场和产业端同时升温。背景是过去两年AI应用大多停留在技术demo和概念验证阶段，烧钱多、收入少。现在情况变了，8月4日A股AI应用板块集体爆发，传智教育、优刻得、凯文教育领涨，说明市场开始用真金白银投票，预期AI应用能产生实际收入。产业层面，AI应用已经下沉到AIGC、政企软件、AI教育、智能制造、智能医疗这些具体场景，从技术验证迈入收入兑现阶段。关键细节有三个：一是方向从编程智能体走向办公智能体，意味着AI的使用者从开发者扩展到普通白领；二是业内判断会先在个人应用领域爆发，再延伸到企业组织，这个路径判断很重要；三是商业闭环能否形成，取决于基于AI的新商业模式能否诞生，而不是简单把AI塞进旧产品里。对供应链领域来说，这意味着AI在排程、优化、决策这类场景的落地会加速，但前提是能算清楚ROI。

供应链.body: Bet on information If test loss flatlines after 1.5B parameters while training loss continues to drop as you scale, that tells you that your model is limited by the amount of information in your data. Training on a single, smallish data set exposed an information gap: the 3.1B model falls off the scaling trend. Neither parameters nor compute will improve performance past this wall. For predicting changes to gene expression, you need more information rich data . This is what Chu and Bo’s teams have done, and here is what ~30x the information buys you: Now we can scale with parameters and training compute! We don’t know how much this effort costed, but we can guess that data collection experiments and infrastructure was a few tens of millions, and compute + headcount + research was a few million. The budget looks like a RL rollout budget, rather than a data rich pre-training one. We were lucky enough to have the two central figures in this story on our podcast. Taking the lead from Ci Chu and Bo Wang, Xaira Therapeutics is betting that information rich data is the key to AI-driven drug development. Chu was recently promoted to Chief Discovery Officer and Bo to Chief AI Scientist 1 , underscoring just how strategic Xaira considers this bet. Reverse engineering the human cell If you had to figure out how a human cell works, what would you do? A good place to start might be by documenting what genes are expressed (e.g. what RNA is floating around) in different kinds of cells, in different circumstances. That is CELLxGENE , a database of 168M cells built by Chan Zuckerberg Institute that maps each cell to a count of how many times 20K-30K genes were detected in that cell, plus detailed metadata about every cell . A ~4 trillion-entry matrix. If the Protein Data Bank (PDB) unlocked structural biology models ( Boltz Episode , ESM/BioHub Episode ), CELLxGENE has done the same thing for Virtual Cell models. Like PDB, CELLxGENE has inspired a zoo of AI models of RNA expression; so much so that RNA expression models have become synonymous with Virtual Cell models. Bo Wang built one of the most influential, scGPT , that became the starting point for Xaira’s new model. RNA expression ≠ Virtual Cell Models trained on CELLxGENE describe the relationship between cell types and cell states, but they are not good at predicting what will happen if we make changes to RNA expression. Changes in gene expression are highly correlated, and its is difficult (impossible) to figure out what causes what in most cases. If you could “turn the dial down” on one gene at a time, however, then you would be able to observe what is upstream and downstream of a given gene 2 . You could tell if A → B & C or B → A & C or B → A, C → B → … If you did this for all of the genes, then maybe you could train a model that could predict what would happen to a cell if you change a gene (e.g. with a drug or a gene edit). Or maybe you could figure out the least invasive way to change a particular gene’s expression. X-Atlas → X-Cell This is exactly what Chu and Bo’s teams have done. The data set is called X-Atlas and the model is called X-Cell. 【一句话讲清楚它在说啥】
Xaira 公司发现，光靠 CELLxGENE 这种静态基因表达数据训练模型，规模再大也撞墙。他们用 CRISPR 并行干扰实验造出带因果信息的数据集 X-Atlas，训练出能预测基因扰动后果的 X-Cell 模型，把药物发现从“看相关性”推向“看因果”。

【详细讲给你听】
这篇文章来自 Latent Space 播客，讲的是 Xaira Therapeutics 在 AI 药物发现上的一个新打法。背景是，之前行业里很多人用 CELLxGENE 这个数据库训练“虚拟细胞”模型。CELLxGENE 是 Chan Zuckerberg 研究所建的，里面有 1.68 亿个细胞的基因表达数据，相当于一个 4 万亿条目的矩阵。但问题来了，这类模型只能描述“什么细胞在什么状态下表达什么基因”，它学的是相关性，不是因果。你问它“如果我把某个基因敲掉，细胞会怎样”，它答不上来。Xaira 的首席科学官 Ci Chu 和首席 AI 科学家 Bo Wang 团队做了一个关键判断：模型参数从 15 亿涨到 31 亿，训练损失还在降，但测试损失不动了，说明数据里的信息量到头了。于是他们搞了个叫 X-Atlas 的数据集，用 CRISPR 技术并行做数百万个基因扰动实验，逐个“拧动”基因开关，记录下游变化。这个数据集的信息量大约是原来的 30 倍。基于它训练的 X-Cell 模型，放弃了自回归，改用扩散模型，能真正预测基因扰动后的细胞状态变化，而且能泛化到真实实验室的人体细胞实验。整个项目成本估计在几千万美元量级，更像强化学习的 rollout 预算，而不是传统预训练的数据采购预算。说白了，这家公司赌的是：信息丰富的因果数据，才是 AI 驱动药物发现的真正壁垒。

【关键术语小词典】
CELLxGENE：单细胞基因表达数据库，由 Chan Zuckerberg 研究所维护，含 1.68 亿细胞数据。
CRISPR：基因编辑技术，能精准“敲掉”或修改特定基因，用于制造扰动实验。
X-Atlas：Xaira 自建的因果扰动数据集，基于 CRISPR 并行实验生成。
X-Cell：基于 X-Atlas 训练的虚拟细胞模型，用扩散模型预测基因扰动后果。

第一，这给你一个跟客户聊“数据质量 vs 模型规模”的绝佳案例。做供应链排程优化时，客户常问“模型够不够大”，你可以用这个例子说明：如果输入数据里没有因果信息（比如只有历史订单，没有“如果改交期会怎样”的扰动数据），参数再多也白搭。第二，这个“信息瓶颈”的判断方法可以直接迁移到你的产品里。你可以在排产算法里做类似诊断：当训练损失下降但验证损失平了，就该回头补数据，而不是堆参数。下次跟客户做 POC 时，可以主动提这个思路，显得你懂底层逻辑。第三，Xaira 用扩散模型替代自回归做时序预测，这个选择也值得琢磨。供应链里很多预测问题也是高维相关的，扩散模型对“多峰分布”的建模能力可能比自回归更适合处理“多种可行排程方案”的场景。

供应链.body: PipeNetwork/minimax-h3-mlx MiniMax released MiniMax-H3 two days ago - they describe it as a "a general-purpose, omni-modal generative system", which in practice means it accepts text, images, audio and video and can use them to generate up to 15 second video clips with audio included. This Python package ports it to MLX for running on Apple Silicon. I got it running on my M5 Max MacBook Pro. I cloned the repo and ran the model like this: # First download the models uvx --from huggingface_hub hf download MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 \ --include 'FL2VA/*' --exclude 'FL2VA/transformer/*' uvx --from huggingface_hub hf download pipenetwork/MiniMax-H3-MLX-8bit # Now run the prompt uv run --with mlx-vlm \ --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/generate.py \ "a rainbow colored skunk leaps over a mossy log in a supermarket" \ -o skunk.mp4 \ -c ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--MiniMaxAI--MiniMax-H3/snapshots/fa9c8ab1eaa21c8ae25e7e40b83b2e6002f340af/FL2VA \ -t ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--pipenetwork--MiniMax-H3-MLX-8bit/snapshots/3ac52081470b0488921c3ec3ba84a39097bf2361 Here's the video I got for the prompt: a rainbow colored skunk leaps over a mossy log in a supermarket Your browser does not support HTML5 video. It downloaded ~115 GB of model files, and the video generation took just under 45 minutes. The video is impressive, but the audio is weird speech-like garbage, because I didn't provide any prompt guidance as to what the audio should be. The prompting guide (which I didn't read prior to this experiment) has a whole bunch of information on how to get this to work. Tags: ai , generative-ai , mlx , text-to-video , minimax

【对你有啥用】
第一，FLUX 3 的多模态统一思路值得借鉴。你做的决策智能平台如果涉及多源数据融合，比如供应链里的文本订单、图像质检、视频监控，这种"一个模型吃所有模态"的架构设计可以给你产品架构上的启发。第二，FLUX3-mimic 的工厂场景预测能力，直接对应你服务的电池、医药、钢铁客户。下次聊方案时，可以提"现在视频生成模型都能做机器人动作预测了，咱们的排产模拟是不是也能往这个方向演进"，这能打开客户对 AI 能力的认知边界。第三，开源权重版本对你们做企业级平台是利好，意味着可以私有化部署视频生成能力，不用受限于闭源 API 的成本和数据合规问题，这在你跟客户谈部署方案时是个加分项。
